mapper.sql: id, session_id, status, total_score, dimension_scores_json, hiring_recommendation, strengths_json, weaknesses_json, follow_up_findings_json, project_mastery_json, knowledge_gaps_json, study_suggestions_json, failure_reason, retry_count, generated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report( session_id, status, total_score, dimension_scores_json, hiring_recommendation, strengths_json, weaknesses_json, follow_up_findings_json, project_mastery_json, knowledge_gaps_json, study_suggestions_json, failure_reason, retry_count, generated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{totalScore}, #{dimensionScoresJson}, #{hiringRecommendation}, #{strengthsJson}, #{weaknessesJson}, #{followUpFindingsJson}, #{projectMasteryJson}, #{knowledgeGapsJson}, #{studySuggestionsJson}, #{failureReason}, #{retryCount}, #{generatedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_report SET status = 'REPORT_FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('REPORT_PENDING', 'REPORT_READY')
UPDATE interview_report SET status = 'REPORT_PENDING', failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'REPORT_FAILED'

UPDATE interview_report SET status = 'REPORT_READY', total_score = #{totalScore}, dimension_scores_json = #{dimensionScoresJson}, hiring_recommendation = #{hiringRecommendation}, strengths_json = #{strengthsJson}, weaknesses_json = #{weaknessesJson}, follow_up_findings_json = #{followUpFindingsJson}, project_mastery_json = #{projectMasteryJson}, knowledge_gaps_json = #{knowledgeGapsJson}, study_suggestions_json = #{studySuggestionsJson}, failure_reason = NULL, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('REPORT_PENDING', 'REPORT_FAILED')
